title: 第3507章 果真有效第3506章 该我封锁了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：葬天神帝第3507章果真有效！
（..la）另一边。
剩下的三十多艘战船，以及六十多尊来自冥月破晓古仙一族的中高位仙君，被光耀仙帝一扇子吹飞到了葬天大陆近旁。
虽然这样做，不免让那些战船出现了不少裂痕，那些中高位仙帝身上出现了不少创伤……
但却省去了他们赶路的时间，直接来到了目标跟前。
“诸位，给我杀进去，彻底摧毁这座大陆！”
一尊九步仙君手持一柄半步太初仙器级别的仙剑，朝着葬天大陆的方向遥遥一指，大声命令道。
此人名号“光辉至尊”
，乃是冥月破晓古仙一族的太上大长老。
虽不是仙帝，却足以比肩仙帝。
光是他的常规战力，就已经勉强接近了一步仙帝！
彻底爆发之后，能够展现出来的终极战力，甚至还要超越一尊两步仙帝，恐怖到了极点。
随着他的一声令下，剩下的那些战船，以及其他那些中高位仙君，立马朝着葬天大陆猛冲而去。
谁知。
就在这时。
嗡！
嗡！
嗡！
伴随着一阵阵剧烈无比的时空震荡，周围时空乱流深处，一座座恐怖大阵，接连启动。
居然每一座，都是太初级别的杀伐大阵、干扰大阵、困封大阵！

咻！
其中一座大阵，汇聚全部力量，化作一道毁灭光波，径直朝着一艘战船激射而去！
“轰隆！”
一声巨响，那艘战船猛然炸开！
就连那座战船之上的几十尊仙王，数百尊高位天仙，也纷纷肉身破碎，神魂湮灭！
就连他们的修炼核心，也各个分崩离析。
短时间内，休想重塑真身。
唰！
另一座大阵仙光喷涌，竟是演化出一柄紫色仙剑，骤然飞出，无视距离，无视防御，将一尊来自冥月破晓古仙一族的七步仙君直接斩爆！
然而！
那尊七步仙君被斩爆后，留下来的修炼核心，居然多达千枚以上。
光是仙君级别的修炼核心，就有将近十枚。
下一刻。
那些修炼核心纷纷血肉滋生，塑造肉身。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 3507 of Burying the God Emperor is really effective!
(..la) the other side.
The remaining thirty warships and more than sixty middle- and high-ranking immortal kings from the Mingyue Dawn Ancient Immortal Clan were blown away by the Emperor Guangyao's fan to the vicinity of the Burial Sky Continent.
Although doing so would inevitably cause a lot of cracks to appear on those warships, and a lot of wounds would appear on the middle and high-ranking Immortal Emperors...
But it saved them the time of rushing and arrived directly at the target.
"Everyone, fight in and completely destroy this continent!"
A Nine-Step Immortal Lord held a half-step Immortal Sword at the level of Taichu Immortal Weapon. He pointed far away in the direction of Burial Sky Continent and shouted an order.
This person's name is "Glory Supreme"
, is the Supreme Elder of the Ming Yue Dawn Ancient Immortal Clan.
Although he is not an Immortal Emperor, he is comparable to the Immortal Emperor.
His regular combat power alone is already barely close to the Immortal Emperor!
After a complete explosion, the ultimate combat power that can be displayed can even surpass a two-step immortal emperor, which is terrifying to the extreme.
Following his order, the remaining warships, as well as the other mid- and high-ranking Immortal Lords, immediately rushed towards Burial Sky Continent.
Who knows.
Just then.
Buzz!
Buzz!
Buzz!
Accompanied by bursts of extremely violent space-time oscillations, in the depths of the surrounding space-time turbulence, terrifying formations were activated one after another.
Unexpectedly, every one of them is a killing array, a disrupting array, and a trapping array of too low a level!
call out!
One of the large formations gathered all its power and turned into a wave of destructive light, shooting straight towards a warship!
"Boom!"
There was a loud noise, and the warship suddenly exploded!
Even the dozens of immortal kings and hundreds of high-ranking immortals on the warship had their bodies shattered and their souls annihilated!
Even their cultivation core fell apart.
In a short period of time, there is no chance of rebuilding the true body.
Uh-huh!
Another large array of fairy light spurted out, and actually evolved into a purple fairy sword, which suddenly flew out, ignoring the distance and defense, and directly killed a seven-step fairy king from the Mingyue Dawn Ancient Immortal Clan!
However!
After the Seven-Step Immortal Lord was destroyed, there were more than a thousand cultivation cores left behind.
There are nearly ten cultivation cores at the Immortal Lord level alone.
The next moment.
Those cultivation cores began to breed with flesh and blood, shaping their physical bodies.
